result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the most visible defect is a stuck loading spinner over the loaded “Tokumaru Ramen Bar” image. A few minor clipping/contrast issues are present in horizontally scrolling content and secondary text.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner remains centered on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image even though the image and card content appear rendered, making the state look stuck or broken.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator once the image/content has loaded; if it is meant to be a video/play control, replace it with a clear play icon and proper pressed state.

issues.description: The rightmost items in horizontal sections are clipped at the viewport edge, e.g. “Trattoria Piccol…” and the next category chip after “Healthy” are cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding and a clearer peek/scroll affordance, or ensure partially visible cards have enough offset so clipping looks intentional.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text such as delivery fees and time ranges uses light gray on white and may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase text contrast to meet WCAG AA, especially for delivery price, ETA, and category metadata.
